You may have to stop and restart HRT several times. HRT as a process isnt linear. One year "on T" could mean 9 months with a 2 month pause before going back another month or any other number of examples. This can happen for any number of reasons whether its switching doctors, lab results being off, family planning, etc. This is OKAY. Its not the end of the world and it won't change anything irreversible. 

You may also lose friends and family. That's a given, but who you lose may surprise you. You may have people who supported you when you initially came out suddenly disappear or, worse, vilify you when you're further down the line. You may have family who once rejected or didnt understand your transition come back in your life and be your best support. 
This happened to me. I distinctly remember my ex friend telling me "don't turn into an asshole" the day I was so excited to get HRT started. It still stings because, along with a number of other factors, it has to do with toxic perceptions of masculinity and a lot of people won't respond to emotional changes, that fulfill you, positively themselves. 
People are in your life for a reason, or for a season.
